documentation.title: Create Generative AI Apps on Google Cloud
documentation.excerpt: learn about generative AI applications and how you can use prompt design and retrieval augmented generation (RAG) to build powerful applications using LLMs.
documentation.overview: Covers prompt design and retrieval augmented generation for production oriented LLM applications, including building an LLM and RAG chat app.

documentation.title: ML Pipelines on Google Cloud
documentation.excerpt: The first few modules will cover about TensorFlow Extended (or TFX), which is Google’s production machine learning platform based on TensorFlow
documentation.overview: Introduces TFX pipeline components and orchestration, then covers repeatable pipelines, continuous training, Cloud Composer, and MLflow.

badges.title: Responsible AI for Developers: Privacy & Safety
badges.profileTitle: Responsible AI for Developers: Privacy & Safety

documentation.title: Responsible AI for Developers: Privacy & Safety
documentation.excerpt: This course introduces important topics of AI privacy and safety.
documentation.overview: Explains practical ways to apply privacy and safety practices with Google Cloud products and open source tools.

badges.title: Responsible AI for Developers: Fairness & Bias
badges.profileTitle: Responsible AI for Developers: Fairness & Bias

documentation.title: Responsible AI for Developers: Fairness & Bias
documentation.excerpt: This course introduces concepts of responsible AI and AI principles.
documentation.overview: Covers recognizing and mitigating bias, then applying responsible AI practices with Google Cloud and open source tools.

badges.title: Build a Certification Study Guide: PMLE
badges.profileTitle: Build a Certification Study Guide: PMLE

documentation.title: Build a Certification Study Guide: PMLE
documentation.excerpt: Learn how to use Gemini Notebook to create a personalized study guide for the Professional Machine Learning Engineer (PMLE) certification exam.
documentation.overview: Shows how to create a Gemini Notebook study guide and use it to practice for the Professional Machine Learning Engineer certification.

badges.title: Responsible AI for Developers: Interpretability & Transparency
badges.profileTitle: Responsible AI for Developers: Interpretability & Transparency

documentation.title: Responsible AI for Developers: Interpretability & Transparency
documentation.excerpt: This course introduces concepts of AI interpretability and transparency.
documentation.overview: Explains why transparency matters to developers and engineers and presents practical ways to improve interpretability in data and models.

badges.title: Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) with Agent Platform: Model Evaluation
badges.profileTitle: Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) with Agent Platform: Model Evaluation

documentation.title: Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) with Agent Platform: Model Evaluation
documentation.excerpt: This course equips machine learning practitioners with the essential tools, techniques, and best practices for evaluating both generative and predictive AI models.
documentation.overview: Covers evaluation measures and methods for generative and predictive models, using Agent Platform for model selection, optimization, and ongoing monitoring.

badges.earnedTitle: Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) with Vertex AI: Model Evaluation

badges.title: Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) for Generative AI
badges.profileTitle: Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) for Generative AI

documentation.title: Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) for Generative AI
documentation.excerpt: This course is dedicated to equipping you with the knowledge and tools needed to uncover the unique challenges faced by MLOps teams
documentation.overview: Describes operational challenges for generative AI deployments and how Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform can streamline MLOps work.

documentation.title: Attention Mechanism
documentation.excerpt: a powerful technique that allows neural networks to focus on specific parts of an input sequence
documentation.overview: Introduces how attention focuses neural networks on relevant input and how it supports translation, summarization, and question answering.

badges.title: Enterprise Search on Generative AI App Builder
badges.profileTitle: Enterprise Search on Generative AI App Builder

documentation.title: Enterprise Search on Generative AI App Builder
documentation.excerpt: Enterprises of all sizes have trouble making their information readily accessible to employees and customers alike.
documentation.overview: Explains how organizations can make scattered internal documents and broad consumer-facing catalogs easier to search. Learners use Generative AI App Builder to add generative search to their applications.

badges.title: Introduction to Vertex Forecasting and Time Series in Practice
badges.profileTitle: Introduction to Vertex Forecasting and Time Series in Practice

documentation.title: Introduction to Vertex Forecasting and Time Series in Practice
documentation.excerpt: This course is an introduction to building forecasting solutions with Google Cloud.
documentation.overview: Covers forecasting on Google Cloud from sequence-model and time-series foundations through data preparation, model development, and Vertex AI deployment. A retail example informs a final exercise in which learners build their own forecasts.

documentation.title: Vector Search and Embeddings
documentation.excerpt: Explore AI-powered search technologies, tools, and applications in this course.
documentation.overview: Introduces AI-powered search patterns including semantic search with vector embeddings, hybrid retrieval that combines semantic and keyword methods, and retrieval-augmented generation. Learners use Vertex AI Vector Search to build a grounded search experience and can continue with related GEAR content.

documentation.title: Machine Learning Operations (MLOps): Getting Started
documentation.excerpt: This course introduces participants to MLOps tools and best practices for deploying, evaluating, monitoring and operating production ML systems on Google Cloud.
documentation.overview: Introduces Google Cloud tools and practices for deploying, evaluating, monitoring, testing, and automating production machine-learning systems. It describes how ML engineers work with data scientists to improve deployed models with discipline and speed.

documentation.title: Machine Learning in the Enterprise
documentation.excerpt: This course takes a real-world approach to the ML Workflow through a case study.
documentation.overview: Uses a case study of an ML team to examine business requirements, data governance, and preprocessing choices. Learners compare AutoML, BigQuery ML, and custom training for two example workloads.

documentation.title: Launching into Machine Learning
documentation.excerpt: The course begins with a discussion about data: how to improve data quality and perform exploratory data analysis.
documentation.overview: Builds from data-quality practices and exploratory analysis into AutoML, BigQuery ML, and model optimization. It also covers generalization and sampling as ways to assess models trained for custom machine-learning tasks.

badges.title: Introduction to AI and Machine Learning on Google Cloud
badges.profileTitle: Introduction to AI and Machine Learning on Google Cloud

documentation.title: Introduction to AI and Machine Learning on Google Cloud
documentation.excerpt: This course introduces Google Cloud's AI and machine learning (ML) capabilities, with a focus on developing both generative and predictive AI projects.
documentation.overview: Surveys Google's AI and machine-learning products for both generative and predictive projects. Interactive exercises connect tools across the data-to-AI lifecycle for data scientists, AI developers, and ML engineers.

documentation.title: Introduction to Generative AI
documentation.excerpt: It also covers Google Tools to help you develop your own Gen AI apps.
documentation.overview: Introduces generative AI, common applications, and its differences from traditional machine learning. The course also points learners to Google tools for creating their own generative AI applications.
